news.summary: Indian equities ended marginally higher after surrendering most intraday gains amid volatile trading. Geopolitical tensions, elevated crude prices and rupee weakness kept sentiment cautious, while analysts expect Q1 earnings and key US economic cues to drive near-term market direction.

news.title: Sun Pharma among 5 stocks that hit 52-week highs & rallied up to 20% in a month
news.summary: The Sensex gained 130 points on Wednesday, while five BSE 200 stocks—Paytm, Divi's Laboratories, Torrent Pharmaceuticals, Sun Pharmaceutical Industries and Apollo Hospitals—hit fresh 52-week highs, reflecting strong buying interest, improving sentiment and sustained bullish momentum.

news.title: HDFC AMC Q1 Results: Net profit rises 12% to Rs 837 crore, revenue up 14%

news.title: Global Market: Foreign investors add $132 billion to US securities in May as equity demand stays strong
news.summary: According to Reuters, the Treasury's monthly Treasury International Capital (TIC) report showed that net long-term purchases by foreign investors reached $1.33 trillion over the 12 months through May, reflecting sustained overseas demand for U.S. assets.

news.title: Global Market: ASML raises 2026 outlook as AI boom drives strong earnings, plans capacity expansion
news.summary: ASML raised its 2026 revenue guidance to €43-45 billion, up from €36-40 billion, after beating Q2 estimates on surging AI chipmaking demand, sending shares up 5.7% as the company plans a 30% capacity boost for its EUV systems over the next two years.

news.title: HDFC Life Insurance Company Q1 results: Profit rises 12% YoY to ₹611 crore; VNB up 9%
news.summary: HDFC Life Insurance Company reported a 12% YoY rise in its standalone profit to ₹611.42 crore for Q1FY27. Value of new business (VNB) for the quarter rose by 9% YoY to ₹879 crore.

news.title: Expert view: Nifty may touch 27,000 by the year end or early next year, says Rohit Srivastava of Indiacharts
news.summary: Market strategist Rohit Srivastava predicts the Nifty 50 index could reach 27,000 by the end of this year or early next year. He advises investors to buy dips and focus on growth stocks despite geopolitical uncertainties that threaten short-term stability.

news.title: Small-cap FMCG stock Spice Lounge Food Works hits upper circuit after this business update
news.summary: Small-cap FMCG stock Spice Lounge Food Works hit its upper circuit on the BSE on Wednesday, 15 July, a day after the company announced it had opened its first Wing Zone Outlet in Bengaluru.
